title: Maximum Difference Between Even and Odd Frequency I
summary: Given a string of lowercase English letters, determine the greatest difference between the frequency of an odd-count character and an even-count character.
statement: Given a string of lowercase English letters, determine the greatest difference between the frequency of an odd-count character and an even-count character.
constraints: Count every lowercase character in s.
Choose one character with odd frequency and one with even frequency.
Return the maximum odd frequency minus the minimum even frequency.
hints: Among odd counts, the largest maximizes the positive term.
Among even counts, the smallest minimizes the subtracted term.
Their difference is therefore maximal over all allowed character pairs.
editorial: Their difference is therefore maximal over all allowed character pairs.

tests.explanation: a occurs five times and b twice, giving the maximum difference three.
The best odd frequency is three and the even frequency is two, giving one.
